Rippling raised $500M in ~12 hours after $300M got frozen at SVB, moving primary banking to JPMC and getting engineers to work overnight so payroll could still go out to customers.
Rippling sued Deel alleging Deel recruited a spy inside Rippling who searched Slack for sensitive terms tied to upcoming news stories and was caught via a honeypot channel with fake CRO chats.
When Rippling obtained an Irish court order to seize the alleged spy's phone, the individual reportedly hid in a bathroom then fled the building rather than hand it over.
Slack activity is logged - every channel view, message, or search is recorded - which let Rippling trace the alleged spy's suspicious searches for terms like 'tinybird', 'russia', and 'sanctions'.
official CLI documented at https://github.com/Rippling/rippling-cli
